notes.title: Changelog 1.5: Steam Deck Verified and Stutter Fix!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thank you for your patience.

Big thanks to everyone who took the time and effort to find and report and bugs or issues, its helped us figure out what needs to be worked on very quickly and we appreciate it so much.

[b]Below is the list of changes :[/b]

[list]
[*] General performance improvements
[*] [h3][b]Reduced camera stutter[/b][/h3]
[*] Added game over cutscenes to the Cutscene Gallery (May have to die again to unlock them) 
[*] Fixed dialogue speed being slow in some situations
[*] Fixed bug that could soft-lock you on the Map UI screen
[*] [h3][b]Replaced steam's Easy Mode option with an in-game menu for selecting a difficulty when starting a new game[/b][/h3]
[*]Fixed the game completion icon not being visible at the defeat of the final boss (continue a save and re-save to see it)
[*] Changed the Easy Mode starter items
[*] Fixed missing Beatrix dialogue line when beating the game and completing every quest (Talking to her now will show you the line if you've already done the quests. Also, we're still planning to revamp the final reward given here)
[*] Various equipment UI fixes
[*] Various gallery UI fixes
[*] Various quest UI fixes (including scrolling not working in languages other than English)
[*] Various map UI fixes
[*] Various gacha collection UI fixes
[*] [h3][b]Attacks now play on button pressed instead of button release[/b][/h3]
[*] Fixed a bug causing the Long Distance Relationship quest to not appear as active or not give the quest item
[*] Removed weird sound playing when loading a save file
[*] Fixed bug that would show you had done every quest when you still had 1 to go.
[*] Reduced the chance of getting stuck on ground corners
[*] Automatically pause the game when the game's window loses focus
[*] Talking to Bad Boy after completing Long Distance Relationship quest now gives you 500 coins and plays a 'kaching' sound.
[*] Removed invisible damage dealing block in Tengoku
[*] Fix to prevent player's cheesing the Goblin Queen
[*] Fixed the stunned fx appearing on stunned enemies after killing them and re-entering their room
[*] Fixed duplicate stunned fx appearing on stunned enemies
[*] Increased the accuracy of Magnetic Hairpin magnetised objects
[*] Fixed the Ex-Boyfriend room door not staying open after unlocking
[*] Increased the damage done by the final charged ranged attack
[*] Fixed the Snapping Plant Enemy being able to attack during its death animation
[*] Fixed toxic slime puddles hovering above the ground slightly
[*] Added small fx to toxic slime puddles for when the player touches them
[*] Cleaned up the Jigoku background
[*] Improved ambience to Jigoku
[*] Added charge up sound to Ghost Boss beam
[*] Fixed Natasha's interact area being too high up 
[*] Fixed Dr. Witch Doctor missing some attack sounds
[*] Added a missing exit from Fungal Forest to the map
[*] Fixed the Tako Red Enemy hitbox not damaging the player correctly
[*] Updated Belle's cutscene
[*] Added a Mind Mushroom sound to the Heavenly Daikon room
[*] Fixed Pandora's beams rotating incorrectly
[*] Fixed Pandora's melee attack doing only a tiny amount of damage
[*] Fixed the large Chaos Witch midpoint cutscene not resetting her to her correct idle animation
[*] Fixed some beam sounds continuing to play their sound after a fight has ended
[*] Updated credits for voice actors and other contributors
[*] Fixed a missing interact animation for Rover
[/list]

[h3]This is the 'final' big build for this year as we'll be taking some downtime to relax over Christmas, we'll be working on smaller things and adjustments here and there, but bigger stuff will be adjusted and added from Jan next year :)[/h3]

notes.title: Changelog 1.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for your patience on us fixing the issues affecting your gameplay experience.
Please see changes below.

[b]Changelog 1.3[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed dialogue text box becoming invisible after purchasing an item.
[*] Fixed the missing Summoning Stone 2 for the Summoning Stones quest.
[*] Fixed bug that greyed out the continue button if your save file was on the 2nd or 3rd slot. (If this one effected you, your save should still be there!)
[*] Enemies now drop more coins. (Except for 'brutes')
[*] Health and Mana regain from broken jars has been tripled.
[*] Fixed the incorrect dialogue the Psychic NPC gave you.
[*] Added fix to prevent looping audio when returning to main menu.
[*] Changed the particles and damage for the Big Mushroom enemy.
[*] Fixed collision issues with the Ghost Boss slam attack and giant Ghost Boss laser.
[*] Mimic greeting voice changed and improved audio mix.
[*] Deleted some annoyingly placed enemies in Chaos Castle.
[*] Made the pipes more visible on the map screen.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the Fairy Boss mid battle cutscene from playing.
[*] Cleaned up Witchy Woods background.
[*] General audio mix adjustments reducing loudness of some gameplay elements.
[/list]

We're almost finished with fixing below but it's not ready to add in a build :
- Map rework, adding icons of NPC's you've interacted with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/09212d80e5c272c19e4c267027409fcb112bfaa0.png[/img]

- Resolution making Quests Text invisible
- We're looking into Cloud Saves
- Looking into Unity Screen flickering issue

Thank you for staying active and bug reporting. It helps us prioritize what we need to focus on first.

notes.title: Changelog 1.2
notes.content:
[b]CHANGELOG 1.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Mushroom Sub Boss spawning bug.
[*] Fixed issue with achievements not triggering properly. (If already done, missing achievements should unlock on next load)
[*] Increased the player's run speed by roughly 10%.
[*] Added a new loading icon.
[*] Crystal Destroyed cutscene in Witchy Woods now triggers correctly.
[*] Updated the default key bindings for gamepad. (All keys are rebindable, so if the new layout is not to your liking you can adjust them back in the settings > controls menu.)
[*] Fixed the Red Wizard costume that displayed the female player frame when ranged attacking.
[*] Removed debug text from the Goblin Costume.
[*] Fixed missing pixels on the Angler Costume.
[*] Corrected wrong text on frog talismans.
[*] Adjusted the warp point to Cherry Apartment.
[*] Removed the unused secret room in Goblin Caves from the Map Screen.
[*] Removed torches that were on the wrong layer in Tengoku
[*] Fixed a major issue on Chinese tutorial translation
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and for everyone who's taken the time to submit bugs.
We are working on getting to as many as we can and will be doing updated builds often.

We are aware of the screen stuttering and resolution issues and are working on getting those things fixed along with some other minor fixes as soon as possible.

Thank you 
- Momo Games

notes.title: Development Update - December
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/9212f0f541f5408e9f2c75da52696bdfad4a8682.gif[/img]
[h1]Holiday Greetings[/h1]

Hello all, just wanted to make a quick post before the holidays.
Wishing you all a Merry Christmas/Happy Holidays, hope you all are taking care of yourselves and keeping warm.
Personally, we are celebrating Christmas and the team are taking a few days downtime to spend with their families.
So, during the week of Christmas development will slow down, but will be picked up again the week after.
This won't affect our progress, so please don't worry.

Now into the actual update stuff.

[h1]Development Update[/h1]

We have been working hard to hit internal goals, so far we've hit all of them except 1.

We still have 3 bosses to finalise, but are rapidly approaching this point, so we feel our trajectory is doing well.

Our next goal is to piece everything together and test, so we should be able to share a lot more in the New Year.
Alongside this we are also trying to nail down our release date, we are not ready to announce yet but we want you to know that we are actively assessing our options as the game becomes a more final product.

Here's a quick list below of what has been implemented recently.
[list]
[*] Finalised and polished the first 5 bosses of the game.
[*] Added more particle effects that read better on screen.
[*] Finalised and polished the player costumes.
[*] Finalised a lot of Lucky Machine animations.
[*] Continued work on in game quests to unlock scenes
[*] Finalising story dialog
[*] Steam Deck testing (Yes, we got our hands on a steam deck, and plan to release with full support.)
[/list]

[h1]Closing Notes[/h1]

We just want to thank you for your patience as we continue development. We are doing our best to make this a fun and unique game. 
Thank you for waiting and see you in the New Year.
[b][i]- Momo Games Team[/i][/b]

notes.title: Development Update - October
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/008e86b9d9864785406d8d296ae67fb0d9270012.gif[/img]
[i]Old Development Image.. this boss has been updated a lot but for now it's a secret [/i]
[h1]Development Update[/h1]
Hello all, sorry for the delay in updates! We were deep in development and honestly we were so engrossed in so many things we forgot how long it's been since the last one.

Here's an update on progress.

[list]
[*]About 95% of all the enemy animations are finalised + polished (We have just a few small things until we're at 100%)
[*] By the end of the month all the player costume animations will be complete and polished, this months task was to try and finish all of those animations and we've made a lot of progress
[*]We've also made a chunk of progress on boss battles.. with next months goal being to complete them all. 
[*]We are doing a pass on VFX to make things feel even better than before. We have some amazing VFX that make Boss Battles / Items feel much more powerful.
[*]Every quest scene is designed now and slowly being animated as we implement more of the quests.
[*]Music! We have bonus music because at this point all the major tracks we needed are done, so we're just adding more to specific areas and events to make the game even better.
[*]Implemented some new features that will make gameplay a lot more unique. These are 'small wins' that change gameplay significantly. 
[/list]

[h1]Animations and pictures[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/fc71d94e2f221a49c37b694d300771ef16dd7a0f.gif[/img]

Above are a few of the enemies and NPCs that we have finalised. Some of these have been tweeted before but there are a lot we haven't shared as we don't know whether it's better to tweet for marketing or keep them as a secret to discover for players. 

If you have thoughts on this, let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/aa262e561a061ee28faff55b065a6cbe66ee77c9.gif[/img]

This gif is of the Fairy costume that you can obtain in the game. Wearing this allows you to interact differently with certain NPC's and find hidden secrets that weren't available before.


[h1]Closing Notes[/h1]
Thank you for reading the update, as usual we're active on the steam discussions page or twitter and if you have any questions just let us know.

Regarding a release date, we have 2 possible dates in mind but not sure which one it will be so we will see how development goes for the rest of the year.
We are really excited to get the game out as soon as possible but also don't want to jump the gun too much by announcing a date we aren't 100% sure of. 

Thank you again for your patience.
[b]- Momo Games Team[/b]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]General update[/h1]
Hello everyone. 
Just to share some updates as we've been quiet recently.
I want to be clear that if we're not updating/tweeting it doesn't mean that things aren't happening, it just means we're super focused on development and moving things along. 
Thank you for your patience and understanding on that point. :)

Progress is still happening consistently and we're working on a few different areas simultaneously.

We have about 30-40% of the final scenes designed and being animated slowly and we expect this to speed up quite a bit in the next 2 months as we have some more time for development coming up.

We did some small changes to the UI so it's a lot more user friendly and visually pleasing.

While that was happening we are having a lot of conversations to finalise items and passive skills for the character. 

Most importantly, the team is still happy and motivated and we're all looking forward to sharing this game with you all as soon as we can. 
We are all putting a lot of effort into this to make it as fun and rewarding to play as possible.

We would love to share some more of our animated scenes but we also don't want to spoil too much of the surprise. 
We plan to work on some teaser animations that won't give too much away for future updates. :)

Thank you for reading
-[i]Momo Games Team[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/52b36c013a64d364b02d4ac39a0a4f8868a56915.gif[/img]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you from Momo Games team[/h1]
Hello everyone!

Firstly, thank you so much from all the team for helping us reach [b]30,000[/b] wishlists! 
We are so grateful our game has received so much interest and I guarantee that we will be doing our best to make this game as fun as possible.

Development is going well, we are currently implementing all the Boss Battles and Quests. 
This will take time but we will keep you updated as much as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/9e7ff95ecafb119fe8dfca80549f5eb8e46da7ec.gif[/img]


[h1]Unlock Animations anytime with the Toy Machines![/h1]

One of the fun features we implemented is a 'Gashapon' system.

As you explore different areas and find secrets you will also find 'Lucky Coins' that you can use on these machines you'll discover in world.

These are bonus animations you can unlock at any time, and you can choose which 'Theme' interests you most.
For example
[list]
[*] Animal Girls
[*] Sexy Onis
[*] Tentacles
[/list]
We plan to update these machines post release as well with bonus quests/content for quite a long time! 
It's just a fun thing we thought would add some flavour to the game and a way to celebrate big milestones.
[i](Animations below are not final, we don't want to spoil the surprises so we used an old animation from the artist ;))[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/cc05eb0086fc9cca0e437f1a6b4560bba79920b7.gif[/img]

[h1]Boss Animation Teaser[/h1]
We also tweeted an animation of one of the first bosses you will encounter.
'Ghost Boss' [i](Name not final)[/i]

We hope you enjoy some moving images and look forward to our next update when we have more fun stuff to share.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41626557/dd7a3bd4692271d1814e31ba89f8be0e9e120f77.gif[/img]

If you want to see some small updates more frequently you can follow us on twitter:
[url=https://twitter.com/MomoEroge]MomoGames[/url]

Thank you and take care -
Momo Games Team
